title: Exercise demo clips are downloaded from the founder's personal GitHub account, fixed inside every installed copy
what: The demo films are not in the app. Each phone fetches them, the first time an exercise is opened, from a public release on one personal GitHub account under the old ForgeAI name. That address is written into every installed copy. If the account is renamed, locked or lost, the repository is made private, or the release is deleted, every phone that has not yet opened a clip shows no clip at all, with no message, and only a new app version can point elsewhere. A failed download is only written to the phone's own log, so nobody at MettleUp would notice. Nothing in this part of the app says who holds that account or how to get back in. Checked today: the address answers (redirect to the file).
expected: The clips sit on a MettleUp-owned address (or are bundled), the account holding them is written down with its way back in, and a clip that cannot be fetched is noticed by MettleUp.
how_often: only if that GitHub account or release is lost, but then on every phone
fix_line: Host the clips on a MettleUp-owned address and write down who holds that account

items.reason: This area is pure training maths, plans and clip download on the member's phone; it holds no gym setup, data import for gyms, support window, billing or offboarding. The routine file import is member-to-member sharing, covered under the member journeys.
The only daily owner chore here is approving a new demo clip: one line per clip in the clip list, kept in step with the clip queue by a test. No other owner task lives in this area.

Member help articles for plans, progress, records, badges, ready today, quick workout and Ask an AI match what this engine does (plan builder questions, 4-week AI text without name, phone or body weight, three readiness states, time-based quick workout). No mismatch found.
No contact-us path, support address or help button in this area; a search for contact, support, WhatsApp and mail links found none.
The only outside account this area uses is the GitHub release holding the demo clips: a personal account baked into every copy. No keys or tokens are in this area.
